Chinese Union Version 1919 (simplified). Public domain. Text via eBible.org and HelloAO. Flattened to a verse map for lookup. 圣经版权与致谢

Psalm 99:2 (KJV) “The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.”

这一节的讲解仍是英文。上面的经文是今天的官方经文——不是轮换的安慰句。

当时在发生什么

The Lord reigns in Zion, holy and high above the people. The verse: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

这是什么意思

The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

谁在说话

Israel’s congregation before the Holy One in Zion

谁听见这话

Worshipers who need to know who is actually high — and you in the hour this verse is for: “The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.”

这话怎样对着 2026 说话

In 2026, The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people. The verse still says: “The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.”

这话现在怎样对你说

This word is for you in the hour this verse is for: “The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.”

今天一个诚实的下一步

Write this where you will see it: “The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.”

一句简单的祷告

Lord, let this word be true in me today: “The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people”. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
